releases.body:
Real-time AI generation speed and token throughput monitor for OpenCode. Displays live TPS metrics in the TUI status bar while the model generates output.

## Install

```bash
npm install opencode-tps-plugin
```

Add to your `tui.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "plugin": ["opencode-tps-plugin"]
}
```

## Highlights

- Real-time TPS / average / token count / elapsed display in `session_prompt_right`
- Speed-based color coding with configurable thresholds
- Tool-execution awareness with net generation time calculation

Requires OpenCode >= 1.15.13 and Node.js 18+.
